purpose: Add 7 optional per-stage model configuration fields (synthesisModel, verificationModel, metaReviewModel, explanationModel, conversationModel, analysisModel, auditModel) to enable fine-grained model selection per pipeline stage, with backward-compatible fallback to reviewModel when unset.
riskRationale: Core library changes (types, schemas, engine.ts, meta-review) are well-structured and backward-compatible, but three integration-layer issues in Action and App wrappers need fixing before merge. None break existing functionality.

text: Well-structured PR that cleanly extends AgentConfig with 7 new optional model fields and a centralized resolveModel() helper. The lib types/schemas/engine changes are correct and consistent. However, three integration issues in the Action and App wrappers need fixing before merge: action.yml defaults prevent the intended fallback chain from activating, auditModel is parsed but never wired into AgentConfig, and the App's MetaReviewEngine receives DEFAULT_CONFIG instead of env-based buildConfig().

reasoning: Core library implementation is correct and backward-compatible, but three important integration issues must be fixed. All are straightforward and safe for automated fixing.

message: The resolveModel() helper cleanly centralizes fallback logic with strict TypeScript keyof Pick<AgentConfig, ...> type narrowing, preventing typos and ensuring all per-stage model lookups follow the same pattern.
All 7 new optional model fields are clearly documented with JSDoc and correctly typed as optional (string?) with undefined defaults, maintaining backward compatibility.
Consistent fallback chain applied uniformly across all model fields in parseInputs(), making action inputs predictable and uniform.

auditModel is parsed by parseInputs() but never assigned to the AgentConfig object. The config construction block maps reviewModel, fixModel, and the 6 new per-stage fields but omits auditModel, making the audit_model action input dead code.
suggestion: Add auditModel: inputs.auditModel to the AgentConfig construction block in action/src/index.ts alongside the other model fields.
suggestionCode:
reviewModel: inputs.reviewModel,
    fixModel: inputs.fixModel,
    auditModel: inputs.auditModel,
    synthesisModel: inputs.synthesisModel,
    verificationModel: inputs.verificationModel,
    metaReviewModel: inputs.metaReviewModel,
    explanationModel: inputs.explanationModel,
    conversationModel: inputs.conversationModel,
    analysisModel: inputs.analysisModel,

message: The 7 new fine-grained model fields all include default: 'opencode/deepseek-v4-flash-free'. Because core.getInput() returns the default when unset, the || globalModel || fallback chain in parseInputs() never activates — these fields are always populated with the hardcoded string, making resolveModel() dead code in the Action path and preventing a central review_model override from cascading to other stages.
suggestion: Remove explicit defaults from all 7 new fine-grained model input fields in action.yml so the fallback chain works as intended.
suggestionCode:
audit_model:
    description: 'Model to use for codebase audit'
    required: false

  synthesis_model:
    description: 'Model to use for synthesizing batch review results'
    required: false

  verification_model:
    description: 'Model to use for meta-verification (false-positive filtering)'
    required: false

  meta_review_model:
    description: 'Model to use for meta-review quality evaluation'
    required: false

  explanation_model:
    description: 'Model to use for PR explanation'
    required: false

  conversation_model:
    description: 'Model to use for interactive conversation'
    required: false

  analysis_model:
    description: 'Model to use for issue analysis'
    required: false

message: MetaReviewEngine receives DEFAULT_CONFIG (imported statically) instead of the env-based buildConfig() result. All other per-event subscribers call buildConfig() fresh per event and pick up env vars, but MetaReviewEngine is constructed once at registration time with bare defaults, so it always uses the hardcoded model regardless of environment variables.
suggestion: Extend registerSubscribers() to accept an optional AgentConfig parameter and have the call site in app/src/index.ts pass the result of buildConfig(). Use resolvedConfig = config ?? DEFAULT_CONFIG for backward compatibility.

message: The model input description says it sets review_model, fix_model, and audit_model but does not mention that it also serves as a global fallback for the 7 new per-stage model fields.
suggestion: Update description to mention that model applies to all pipeline stage model inputs as a global fallback.
